_comment: Maps a record-id prefix (e.g. INC0353896 -> INC) to the entity that record belongs to and the human identifier column to filter on. Extend this when a new module/record type is added -- no code change needed. `entity` is a schema_v3 entity slug (module_entity, e.g. itsm_incident); `id_column` is the human id column (not the *_system_id).
_comment_aliases: OVERLAY ONLY. The obvious aliases are DERIVED from the schema's entity names at load (see record_lookup._derived_entity_aliases): 'incident'/'incidents' -> itsm_incident, 'service request'/'service requests' -> itsm_service_request, 'availability'/'availabilities' -> itsm_availability, and so on for every entity. Do not restate them here. This file is for vocabulary no rule produces -- abbreviations and business words that do not resemble the entity name. Deriving was the fix for a silent class of bug: an alias whose slug is not a real entity slug is DROPPED without error by plan_query (`_identify_entities` filters on loader.all_entities()), so the question just routes to whatever else it mentions -- a hand-typed 'itsm_servicerequest' disabled every service-request question, and 'availability' being absent is why 'incidents that impacted availability percentage' was answered from the major-incident table. An overlay slug that does not exist is now logged as a warning at load.
